claim_text: Authorities launched a search-and-rescue mission after flash floods appeared to sweep several occupied homes off their foundations in coastal communities.
quote: A search-and-rescue mission was launched after flash floods apparently swept several occupied homes off their foundations in coastal communities, authorities said.
confidence_justification: Attributed to unnamed authorities and hedged with 'apparently' in the source itself; below the news ceiling because the report does not settle what happened to the homes.
